5 SYSTEM RESILIENCE
5.1 Recovery Objectives
5.1.1 A financial institution should establish a recovery time objective (RTO)
of not more than 4 hours for each critical system.
5.1.2 The financial institution should test its disaster recovery plan at least
once every 12 months, involving its key service providers.
5.2 Incident Reporting
5.2.1 A financial institution should notify the regulator within 1 hour of
discovering a relevant incident that has a severe and widespread impact.

---page---
FAKE TEST DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL REGULATION
5.2.2 A root cause and impact analysis report should be submitted within
14 days of discovering the incident.

Annex A Glossary
